name: Four Seasons Hotel at the Surf Club
positioning: Oceanfront Four Seasons hotel in Surfside, Florida, set around the original Surf Club clubhouse from 1930
best_for: Beach travelers who want a Four Seasons with a historic clubhouse setting
Families, with a supervised children's club and an adults-only quiet pool

facts.text: The Surf Club first opened its doors on New Year’s Eve 1930.
The hotel is at 9011 Collins Avenue in Surfside, Florida.
Designer Joseph Dirand created the interiors across 77 guest rooms.
Pritzker-prize winning architect Richard Meier has designed three buildings that frame and flank the original clubhouse from 1930.
The Surf Club spans 9 acres surrounded by landscaped seaside gardens.
The hotel is set on a 900 ft stretch of pristine white sand beach.
The spa has six treatment rooms.

highlights.text: The Surf Club Restaurant is Thomas Keller’s first Florida venture.
Lido Restaurant is in The Surf Club’s original ballroom.
Guests can use complimentary bicycles to cruise along the Surfside trail.
Kids for All Seasons is a fully supervised children’s club in its own facility.
Bal Harbour Shops are just five minutes away.

considerations.text: Miami Beach is a 20-minute drive down Collins Avenue from the hotel.
The quiet pool is for adults only.
Valet parking is listed among the hotel’s services.

perks.text: With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, breakfast for two is free daily.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a priority upgrade if available at check-in.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get a $100 hotel credit.
WhataHotel special offers can be combined with the exclusive perks.
With the WhataHotel Preferred Rate, guests get free Wi-Fi access.
